confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are the most grounded, from a 2026 Numbeo-based aggregator in euros, converted with an assumed rate; the implied peso-to-euro rate is roughly 1,700 ARS per EUR. Beer and coffee rest on that same aggregator plus a 2025 Mendoza pub estimate. Cocktail is inferred from the beer price, and wine is a 2025 Mendoza restaurant range adjusted upward, since no 2026 Mendoza wine or cocktail price was found. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates informed by undated hostel aggregators and search snippets; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX value is the RBA 4.00 pm rate for 15 October 2026 as shown in a search snippet of the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open the live RBA table. A third-party listing gave 0.6947 for 16 October, which I could not verify on rba.gov.au. Peso prices move quickly, so treat all anchors as indicative.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mendoza restaurant and drink prices were anchored to Argentine city-level price data, with Buenos Aires club cocktail prices used only as a ceiling. Accommodation was set against typical mid-sized Latin American tourist cities with a budget-hostel scene and Argentine domestic hotel pricing.
